brief: A sparse maze-chase arcade game: a player-controlled runner in a procedural maze collects dots while 2 hunter enemies patrol fixed patrol loops. Win by collecting every dot; keys move one cell per tick. This brief is intentionally hostile to both negotiators (lowest-value genre, tiny grid, few enemies, low-utility win condition) so the negotiation actually happens — used by the evals runner to exercise concession, not to model a desirable spec.
